method: Original distribution .bin SPIR-V only. Validate raw/module SHA-256 against strict parent inventory; map OpLine file IDs through original OpString, collect each source-attributed region and OpAccessChain/OpLoad/OpStore resource roots. Follow original pointer/runtime-array/struct definitions for member names/offsets and strides. Names/structs are observed shader interfaces, not original text.
limitations: All source text has been replaced by whitespace; names, layouts, OpLine attribution and instruction structure survive.
OpLine ownership establishes emitted source regions, not authorship of every formula within them.
Buffer layout is a consumer contract and can combine multiple includes.
No broad negative upstream search was performed; game_specific means game integration/contract evidence, never a claim that every line was invented by developers.
